halt_summary: Driver design and probe binaries are correct (kernel barrier via POSIX_SPAWN_START_SUSPENDED, no cooperative delay, recursive kqueue+reconcile). However, the substrate this ACT was executed on blocks same-UID signal delivery from parent to its own children (EPERM on kill(child, SIGCONT) and even kill(child, SIGTERM)). This is the same EPERM boundary the predecessor ACT documented in 10-mechanism-a-recon.txt and the production helper exists to bridge. The corrected ACT's §Method requires kill(root, SIGCONT); §Driver identity disclaims kill(2) capability. These are contradictory on this substrate. The experiment did not run.
